---
name: Example request
about: Ask for an example that doesn't exist yet
labels: feature
---

## What you're trying to build

The framework, runtime and pattern — e.g. "SvelteKit with streaming", "Bun with
file upload", "Lambda with an assistant".

## What's missing from the existing examples

Is there one that's close? Say which, and what it doesn't cover.

## Have you got it working?

If you already have something running, say so — a working snippet is most of an
example, and we'd rather help you open the PR than rebuild it.

<!--
Every example in this repo must be standalone (its own package.json and
lockfile), backend-runnable (the API key never reaches the browser), type-safe
(`npx tsc --noEmit` passes in CI) and secret-free. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
-->
